problems.title: Two carousels keep animating when nobody can see them
problems.cause: Market Updates and News auto-play every 4–5 s, even off screen and with the market closed.
problems.effect: 13.3 fps of identical frames and about half a CPU core used while the page sits idle.

problems.title: Every scroll event walks the whole widget tree
problems.cause: The sticky section chips search the full element tree, up to 16 times per scroll event.
problems.effect: Scrolling runs at 37 fps with 12 % janky frames.

problems.title: The whole Overview is built at once
problems.cause: All 16 sections are built, expanded and laid out together, and any accordion tap rebuilds all of them.
problems.effect: Slow first paint, heavy scrolling and high memory.

problems.title: Opening the page waits on a chain of calls
problems.cause: Dashboard, getQuote, scrip details and getQuote again run one after another, with 100–300 ms of added delays. About 18 requests go out, 16 of them in series.
problems.effect: 1.3 s repeat open and 2.5 s first open.

problems.title: Tab switches throw the data away
problems.cause: Every switch wipes all tab data, shows a skeleton and fetches everything again.
problems.effect: 900 ms tab switch; Overview takes about 1.4 s behind a skeleton every time.

problems.title: Live prices are subscribed from many places
problems.cause: Widgets subscribe from build(), override each other's symbol sets, never unsubscribe, and rebuild on unchanged ticks.
problems.effect: 465 KB/min of network while idle, plus extra CPU during market hours.

problems.title: Old quote pages stay alive
problems.cause: Tapping a peer or last-visited stock stacks a new quote page on top of the old one, and the chart WebView is never paused.
problems.effect: 1.1 GB of RAM on the quote page, growing to about 2 GB.

problems.title: No chart on the quote page; the full chart is slow to open
problems.cause: The only chart is a full-screen WebView that loads its page and library on the first tap.
problems.effect: More than 7 s to the first chart.

problems.title: Offline is unclear and recovery is slow
problems.cause: There is no banner, frozen prices look live, the Overview can stay on a skeleton, and data refreshes about 9 s after reconnecting.
problems.effect: Users can't tell whether the data is current.

problems.title: Crash and stuck-state risks
problems.cause: A disposed TabController, unguarded list access, force unwraps, emits after close, and error resets that don't clear.
problems.effect: Non-fatal errors and screens stuck on a loader.

outcome.today: none on the page; full chart > 7 s first open
outcome.after: inline chart ≤ 0.5 s; full chart ≤ 2 s

package.title: Major changes possible in 2–4 days

rows.what: Add the shared Remote Config switch holder first; the other dev's C4 needs it too. Then run the carousels only while they are visible, and keep the page index in a ValueNotifier.
Stable section keys, then cache section offsets instead of walking the element tree on every scroll.
Finish B1. Rebuild only the accordion that changed, and build the section list once.
Painters repaint only on real change; no debugPrint in paint and build; MediaQuery.sizeOf; no subscribing or stream creation inside build().
Reuse the first getQuote result, remove the artificial delays, give the price an initial value, drop the wasted and duplicate Overview calls, and remove prints.
Recompute only the Overview section that changed, load Fundamentals in parallel, cap each section call at 6 s, and subscribe the OHLC-only widget to quotes only.
Crash and stuck-state fixes: TabController reference, empty name, force unwraps, emit after close, unguarded list access, catch Error in loaders.
Decode logos at display size and dispose the depth handler. Then a QA regression pass and a re-measure on the same device.
Turn on chart_lib_prefetch_enabled in prod Remote Config. Answer the socket questions about snapshots on re-subscribe and ticks after market close.

effect.after: ≈ 0 fps with the carousels off screen, and a large CPU drop (A1–A3). Idle network is reduced by E2/E3; the rest of it needs E1/E5 later.
Most of the per-scroll UI-thread cost removed (B1), plus fewer rebuilds and repaints (B4, B6, B7, B13, B17). Target ≥ 55 fps; the full ≥ 58 fps needs B10.
About 300–500 ms faster (C3 saves one round trip, C4 100 ms, C8 three fewer requests), no zero-price frame (C6). Reaching ≤ 400 ms needs C2/C7/C10.
200 ms less on every switch (C4), Fundamentals loads in parallel (D4). No-skeleton revisits need D1/D2.
Worst case about 12 s, then partial content or Retry (H3).
Five crash paths and the stuck-loader cases closed (I1–I6).
Library download taken off the first open after G5 is switched on.

package.needs_product: A1 A2: should the carousels rotate only while the user can see them? The change ships behind a switch that keeps today's behaviour until Product says yes.
package.needs_be: G5: turn on chart_lib_prefetch_enabled in prod Remote Config. E12: answer two socket questions: are snapshots sent on every re-subscribe, and are ticks sent after market close?
